title: PHREAKOID (Digitone machine)
author: x2k
description: PHREAKOID, a monophonic acid machine for the Digitone mk1 and Keys: a band-limited saw/square oscillator into the 303's four-pole ladder filter with its feedback highpass, a resonant filter envelope, accent by velocity, glide and a fixed amp envelope, on 16 borrowed stock SYN knobs (SYN1 A-H and SYN2 A-H) so p-locks, LFOs, presets and save work untouched. An integer port of the TB-303 voice in Open303 (MIT). It plays through the Digitone's own AMP envelope, filter, mixer and effects as FM does. A machine, not an effect: needs the machines mod and core-dn1 3.1.
